title: Dorothy Donegan's overplaying attitude
summary: Dorothy Donegan, she says, is the best piano player but tries to outdo everyone and shake and show herself, which makes her unpopular. Humes advises her to just sit and play and smile.

story.theme_name: Where jazz stands today: young players, rock, and the audience
story.community_name: Playing for the audience: communicating from the bandstand
